exposure: Starting labor in primary midwife-led care
Starting labor in secondary obstetrician-led care
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who gave birth beyond 37+0 weeks gestation in the Amsterdam region of the Netherlands between 2005 and 2008. Excluded women with a primary caesarean section or a pregnancy complicated by antepartum death or major congenital anomalies.
finding: Intrapartum and neonatal mortality rates were comparable between women starting labor in primary midwife-led care and those starting in secondary obstetrician-led care, while the intervention rate was significantly lower in the primary care group.
